CREATE SCHEMA silver

CREATE TABLE silver.ta
(
    STUDYID varchar(200),
    DOMAIN varchar(200),
    ARMCD varchar(200),
    ARM varchar(200),
    TAETORD varchar(200),
    ETCD varchar(200),
    ELEMENT varchar(200),
    LANDING_LOAD_TS varchar(200)

);

--DROP TABLE 

COPY INTO silver.ta 
(STUDYID,DOMAIN,ARMCD,ARM,TAETORD,ETCD,ELEMENT,LANDING_LOAD_TS)
FROM 'https://stsyndemo01.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-files/bronze/TA/*.parquet'
WITH (
   FILE_TYPE  = 'PARQUET',
    AUTO_CREATE_TABLE = 'ON'
);



SELECT * FROM silver.ta 

TRUNCATE TABLE silver.ta

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ta
(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    ARMCD VARCHAR(200),
    ARM VARCHAR(200),
    TAETORD INT,
    ETCD VARCHAR(200),
    ELEMENT VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'synapse-files/clintrail_data_files/TA/TA.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsyn011_file_data,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
);


SELECT * FROM ta;
---------------------CETAS--------------------------------------->

CREATE SCHEMA landing


-- use CETAS to export select statement with OPENROWSET result to  storage
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE landing.TA
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'synapse-files/landing/TA/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsyn011_file_data,  
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_parquet
)  
AS
SELECT *, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as LANDING_LOAD_TS FROM dbo.ta;

-- you can query the newly created external table
-- SELECT * FROM population_by_year_state


SELECT * FROM landing.TA;


SELECT *, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as LANDING_LOAD_TS FROM dbo.ta;

DROP EXTERNAL TABLE landing.TA

----------------------------------------->

CREATE SCHEMA bronze

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.ta
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'synapse-files/bronze/TA/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsyn011_file_data,  
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_parquet
)  
AS
SELECT 
UPPER(TRIM(STUDYID)) AS STUDYID ,UPPER(TRIM(DOMAIN)) AS DOMAIN,UPPER(TRIM(ARMCD)) AS ARMCD,
UPPER(TRIM(ARM)) AS ARM,CAST(TAETORD AS INT) AS TAETORD, UPPER(TRIM(ETCD)) AS ETCD ,UPPER(TRIM(ELEMENT)) AS ELEMENT ,LANDING_LOAD_TS
FROM landing.ta;


SELECT 
UPPER(TRIM(STUDYID)) AS STUDYID ,UPPER(TRIM(DOMAIN)) AS DOMAIN,UPPER(TRIM(ARMCD)) AS ARMCD,
UPPER(TRIM(ARM)),CAST(TAETORD AS INT) AS TAETORD, UPPER(TRIM(ETCD)) AS ETCD ,UPPER(TRIM(ELEMENT)),LANDING_LOAD_TS
FROM landing.ta


SELECT * FROM bronze.ta;

(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    USUBJID VARCHAR(200),
    VSSEQ VARCHAR(200),
    VSTESTCD VARCHAR(200),
    VSTEST VARCHAR(200),

    VISITNUM VARCHAR(200),
    VISIT VARCHAR(200),

    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
)

SELECT * FROM VS;


COPY INTO [dbo].[vs] FROM 'https://stsyndemo01.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-files/clintrail_data_files/VS/VS.csv'
WITH (
   FIELDTERMINATOR=',',
   ROWTERMINATOR='0x0A'
) OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.VS');
